journeys.name: First-run
journeys.outcome: Fresh install, launch app, open example, run; editor, typed result and status correct within two primary actions.

journeys.name: Basic script
journeys.outcome: Enter a=2; b=a^10; b; verify result, variables, cursor and log output.

journeys.name: Precision
journeys.outcome: Set precision 20, evaluate sqrt(2), set 1000, rerun; full exact stored digits, visible precision and cache invalidation.

journeys.name: Session isolation
journeys.outcome: Two tabs with x=10 vs x=99 and different precision; switch tabs during run; no state leak.

journeys.name: Concurrent evaluation
journeys.outcome: Start long run A, type and execute B, cancel A; UI stays responsive, B result correct.

journeys.name: Real cancellation
journeys.outcome: Run a cancellation-aware expensive operation; cancel from UI; underlying work terminates, terminal event seen, no pending spinner.

journeys.name: Incremental reuse
journeys.outcome: Run a=2;b=a+1;c=pi(100); edit only independent statement; see actual reused count and correct output.

journeys.name: Dependency invalidation
journeys.outcome: Change a or redefine function f; all transitive dependents recompute; independent statements reuse.

journeys.name: Side effects
journeys.outcome: Repeated `print` and `plot` are executed each requested run; output not duplicated within one run.

journeys.name: Clear semantics
journeys.outcome: Define function f and variable x; Clear Variables removes x but not f; deleting one var preserves all other state.

journeys.name: Autocomplete
journeys.outcome: Type `sq`; completion offers sqrt with signature; define function and variable and see them appear; accepting suggestion edits source predictably.

journeys.name: Error navigation
journeys.outcome: Trigger Unicode multiline error; exact line/column highlighted; error code/category accessible, jump-to-source works.

journeys.name: Structured mathematics
journeys.outcome: Inspect symbolic simplification, matrix inverse, solve record and 1000-digit number without losing exactness metadata.

journeys.name: MathIR inspection
journeys.outcome: Compile symbolic expression, navigate IR and copy byte-preserved IR; unrelated source edits do not reevaluate inspector.

journeys.name: Plot presentation
journeys.outcome: Generate plot with paths, text, axes, clipping; zoom, pan, fit, copy and export SVG/PNG, compare reference screenshot.

journeys.name: File safety
journeys.outcome: Open file, edit, external modify, resolve conflict; save preserving line endings and data; no silent overwrite.

journeys.name: Crash recovery
journeys.outcome: Edit unsaved tab, kill process, relaunch, recover data, reopen tabs and layout without automatically executing.

journeys.name: Theme/scale
journeys.outcome: Switch light/dark, 100/150/200% scale and 900×600 layout; no cropped main actions or unreadable text.

journeys.name: Accessibility
journeys.outcome: Keyboard-only open, edit, run, inspect, export; screen reader announces relevant status/progress/diagnostics.

journeys.name: Stress
journeys.outcome: Open 500KB script, output 100k log messages, render 1MB SVG; measure latency and bound memory.

journeys.name: Offline
journeys.outcome: Disable network entirely and run all primary workflows; no listener, external CDN, or unplanned traffic.

journeys.name: Release evidence
journeys.outcome: Build from clean pinned SHA, run GUI suite, save screenshot/semantic/perf evidence with hashes and source-bound release gate.
